title: Discount in the ad differs from the landing page

evidence.snippet: Ad: "-50% this week only" · Landing page: "-20%" (119,99 lei, was 149,99 lei)

rule: Directive 2005/29/EC, Art. 6(1)(d): misleading action on price advantage
risk: Shoppers who click for half price find 20% off. That reads as bait advertising, drives refunds and complaints, and wastes the click you paid for.
fix: -20% on GlowPure Hydra Cream this week

title: "Buy Now" leads to a page that does not exist (HTTP 404)
risk: Every visitor who decides to buy hits an error page. The campaign cannot convert while this link is broken.
fix: Point "Buy Now" to the live checkout URL and re-test after deploying.

title: "Free delivery" in the ad, but the page charges 19,99 lei shipping
rule: Directive 2005/29/EC, Art. 6(1)(d): price or manner in which price is calculated
risk: Delivery cost appearing only at checkout is a top reason for abandoned carts, and the mismatch may be read as misleading.
fix: Free delivery on orders over 150 lei (or remove "Free delivery" from the ad)

title: Generic environmental claim without supporting evidence

evidence.snippet: No environmental certification or performance data found in the 2 uploaded documents.

rule: Directive 2024/825 (EmpCo), Annex I point 4a: generic environmental claim without recognised excellent environmental performance
risk: Possibly non-compliant with the EmpCo blacklist, which has applied EU-wide since 27 September 2026 with no transition period.
fix: Packaging made with 50% recycled plastic (certified by <scheme>) — or remove "eco-friendly" until you can prove it

title: "Clinically proven" with no study in the product documents

evidence.snippet: No clinical study, panel size or test duration found for the 48h hydration claim.

rule: Regulation (EU) 655/2013, Annex, common criterion 3: evidential support
risk: No evidence found for a measurable cosmetic claim. Authorities can ask for the study at any time.
fix: Hydration that lasts all day* — *add the study reference (panel size, duration) once available

title: Delivery conditions are almost unreadable (contrast 1.5:1)
claim: Delivery: courier shipping 19,99 lei. Returns within 14 days. 2-year warranty.

details.note: Automated checks only: they do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: The shipping cost and warranty are hard to read for low-vision visitors and on phones in sunlight. Hiding conditions in pale text also weakens your position if the price is challenged.
fix: Use #4a4a4a on #e9e9e9 (7.4:1) for the conditions text.

title: Scarcity claim without an inventory source

evidence.snippet: Page text "Only 2 left!" while structured data says availability: InStock (no quantity).

rule: Directive 2005/29/EC, Annex I point 7: false limited availability to force an immediate decision
risk: No evidence found that stock is really limited. Unproven scarcity erodes trust once shoppers notice it never changes.
fix: Show the real stock count from your inventory system, or remove "Only 2 left!".

title: Urgency in the ad and a countdown on the page

evidence.snippet: Ad: "Only today!" and "this week only" · Page: countdown "ends in 02:14:59"

risk: "Only today" and "this week only" contradict each other. If the offer runs longer, the deadline may be read as false urgency.

title: "Order today" button has no destination
risk: If the button really does nothing, visitors who want to buy cannot continue.
fix: Link "Order today" to the checkout, or remove the duplicate button.

title: Cart button has no accessible name

details.note: Automated checks only: they do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: Screen-reader users cannot find the cart, so they cannot complete a purchase.
fix: Add aria-label="Open cart" to the icon button.

title: Product image has no alternative text

details.note: Automated checks only: they do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: Screen-reader users miss what the product looks like and what is offered.

title: Could not verify the reference price for the discount

evidence.snippet: Crossed-out price 149,99 lei. No price history was provided, so the 30-day lowest price could not be checked.

rule: Directive 98/6/EC, Art. 6a: prior price must be the lowest price in the last 30 days
risk: Possibly non-compliant if 149,99 lei was not the lowest price applied in the 30 days before the discount.
fix: Keep a record of the 30-day lowest price, or show it next to the discount: "Lowest price in the last 30 days: 149,99 lei".
